senses.gloss:
योनिद्वार

YONIDVĀRA . A sacred place on the Udaya mountain. (mahābhārata, Vana Parva, Chapter 84, Verse 95).

योनितीर्थ

YONITĪRTHA . A sacred place in North india. A bath in this place will make a person handsome and he will get the reward of a gift of 1000 cows. (M.B. Vana Parva, Chapter 82, Verse 84).
